title: A project can be deferred by a ruling without reading as stuck
ask: The program owner found, working replay-phase-b, that HQ has no way to distinguish a project waiting on a scheduled event by the CES ruling from one that is genuinely stuck. replay-phase-b is deferred by the 2026-09-02 no-fresh-recruiting ruling until the next release nears — nothing impedes it — yet status blocked reads as five-alarm trouble and (were it critical) would false-alarm the release train. Proposal: a status like deferred that carries its wake trigger, counts as neither fire nor a routeless blocker, but stays visible with its trigger shown. This changes what the CEO sees on the das
first_action: Read compute_signals in hq/server.py for every place status==blocked is tested, and hq/data/projects/replay-phase-b.json, then draft the status semantics for the CEO to rule on.
